source_window.resource_title: Find and Comment on Planning Applications Online
source_window.license: No explicit reuse licence stated on the guidance page; Ashford Borough Council website copyright/terms apply.

field_evidence.search_capability: Ashford Borough Council states that its online planning viewer can search by address, postcode, reference number or area.
field_evidence.application_detail_access: The council guidance directs users to open an application reference to view application details and plans.
field_evidence.document_access: The council guidance states that application documents are available from the Files section of the associated application.
field_evidence.target_geometry_limitation: This guidance page does not itself provide the PA/2024/1920 site/location plan, title number, cadastral/title polygon, canonical parcel bbox or target-specific coordinates.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. Ashford Borough Council's official Planning Public Register guidance confirms that applications can be searched by reference/address/postcode/area and that associated application documents are exposed in the application's Files section. However this guidance window does not itself expose the PA/2024/1920 target-specific site/location plan, title identifier, cadastral/title polygon, or parcel bbox. Local OpenCode must retrieve and spatially bind the target-specific application plan or authoritative parcel/title geometry; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official Ashford Borough Council Planning Public Register help page is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from a static planning notice to the council's application-document retrieval workflow. It verifies that the public register supports reference-based search and that application documents can be viewed from the associated application's Files section, but this source window contains no PA/2024/1920 target-specific plan geometry itself. No parcel geometry is inferred from the availability of documents; spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
